# Italian Archive Navigator

> A free, read-only MCP connector for Claude for Italian family-history research. Given a place, a year and an event, it finds what the place was called and which comune it belonged to, which records exist (civil registration, parish registers, military records) and which office holds each copy today, the office's address and certified e-mail (PEC), drafts a request letter in Italian, and formats a citation. Published by fiorfelix.

- Connector address (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in): https://archives-mcp.fiorfelix.com/mcp
- To add it in Claude: Settings, Connectors, add a custom connector with the address above.
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http italian-archive-navigator https://archives-mcp.fiorfelix.com/mcp`
- Coverage is deepest for Lazio, Umbria, Toscana and Marche; place history and office contacts cover all of Italy.
- It does not search Portale Antenati or FamilySearch, does not look up living people, never sends anything on the user's behalf, and does not store request contents.
- Sources: ISTAT and IndicePA open data (CC BY 4.0), the Guida generale degli Archivi di Stato italiani, archive inventories and Italian law on Normattiva. Every rule cites its source; unconfirmed rules are marked unverified.
- Every page below is also available as Markdown at the linked address. The full text of all pages is in https://archives.fiorfelix.com/llms-full.txt.

## Pages (English)

- [Italian Archive Navigator](https://archives.fiorfelix.com/index.md): Find where an Italian ancestor's birth, marriage, death or military record is kept today, the office's address and PEC, and a request letter in Italian. A free connector for Claude.
- [Guides to Italian genealogy records](https://archives.fiorfelix.com/guides.md): Short guides with official sources: where Italian civil records are kept, how to request a copy, renamed towns, and military service records.
- [Italian civil records: Comune or State Archive?](https://archives.fiorfelix.com/guides/comune-or-state-archive.md): Why Italian birth, marriage and death records exist in two originals, which one the Comune keeps, which one is at the Archivio di Stato, and where to look before 1866.
- [Italian military service records (fogli matricolari): where to find them](https://archives.fiorfelix.com/guides/italian-military-records.md): Where Italian Army conscription lists and service records (fogli matricolari) are kept: the State Archive, the Army documentation office, or the Ministry of Defence.
- [When your ancestor's Italian town changed its name](https://archives.fiorfelix.com/guides/italian-town-name-changes.md): Italian comuni have been renamed, merged, split and moved between provinces since 1861. How to find today's comune and the right office for an old place name.
- [How to request an Italian ancestor's birth record](https://archives.fiorfelix.com/guides/request-italian-birth-record.md): Who to write to, what to include, and which kind of copy to ask for (certificate, extract or full copy) when requesting a birth, marriage or death record from Italy.
- [Privacy](https://archives.fiorfelix.com/privacy.md): Privacy policy of the Italian Archive Navigator connector for Claude: no accounts, request contents not stored, logs without addresses.

## Pagine (italiano)

- [Italian Archive Navigator](https://archives.fiorfelix.com/it/index.md): Scopri dove si trova oggi l'atto di nascita, matrimonio, morte o il foglio matricolare di un antenato, l'indirizzo e la PEC dell'ufficio e la lettera di richiesta. Un connettore gratuito per Claude.
- [Guide alla ricerca degli atti degli antenati](https://archives.fiorfelix.com/it/guide.md): Guide brevi con fonti ufficiali: dove si trovano gli atti di stato civile, come chiederne copia, comuni che hanno cambiato nome, fogli matricolari.
- [Se il comune del tuo antenato ha cambiato nome](https://archives.fiorfelix.com/it/guide/comune-cambiato-nome.md): Dal 1861 i comuni italiani sono stati rinominati, fusi, divisi e spostati tra province. Come trovare il comune di oggi e l'ufficio giusto per un vecchio nome di luogo.
- [Atti di stato civile: Comune o Archivio di Stato?](https://archives.fiorfelix.com/it/guide/comune-o-archivio-di-stato.md): Perché gli atti di nascita, matrimonio e morte esistono in due originali, quale conserva il Comune, quale l'Archivio di Stato, e dove cercare prima del 1866.
- [Fogli matricolari e liste di leva: dove trovarli](https://archives.fiorfelix.com/it/guide/fogli-matricolari.md): Dove si trovano le liste di leva e i fogli matricolari dell'Esercito: Archivio di Stato, Ufficio documentale dell'Esercito o Ministero della Difesa.
- [Come richiedere l'atto di nascita di un antenato](https://archives.fiorfelix.com/it/guide/richiedere-atto-di-nascita.md): A chi scrivere, cosa indicare e quale documento chiedere (certificato, estratto per riassunto o per copia integrale) per un atto di nascita, matrimonio o morte.
- [Privacy](https://archives.fiorfelix.com/it/privacy.md): Informativa sulla privacy del connettore Italian Archive Navigator per Claude: nessun account, contenuti delle richieste non conservati, log senza indirizzi.
